# Marky v1.8.10

Major performance release resolving typing lag, editor stutter in complex documents, and optimizations for large vaults.

### Editor Performance & Typing Lag Fixes (#45)

- **Eliminated Widget DOM Destruction on Keystrokes**: In Live Preview mode, widgets (code blocks, math formulas, tables, and task checkboxes) now reuse their existing DOM nodes when typing shifts their document offset, preventing expensive re-parsing, syntax highlighting, and layout thrashing on every keypress.
- **Removed Forced Browser Layout Reflow**: Decoupled outline measurement from keystroke updates to eliminate synchronous `posAtCoords` / `getBoundingClientRect` layout recalculations mid-typing.
- **Optimized Selection & React Re-renders**: Swapped per-character empty selection allocations with a stable singleton, skipped redundant document string inspections, and prevented preview HTML rendering while working in Live or Source view modes.
- **Debounced Outline Parsing**: Outline Rail headings are now debounced and memoized to avoid regex parsing across the full document on every keystroke.

### Large Folder & Workspace Optimizations

- **Memoized Fuzzy Search**: `SearchModal` and `CommandPalette` now memoize their search index with `useMemo`, eliminating full index reconstruction and re-tokenization on every search character.
- **Throttled Vault Loading & Fast Metadata Reuse**: Batch progress updates when loading large folders and preserve existing tags, links, and property metadata when refreshing unchanged notes from disk.
- **Granular Store Subscriptions**: Isolated Zustand state selectors across the application root, tabs, and editor to eliminate cascading re-renders when note contents change.
